## strings and regex
```{r}
string_vec = c("my", "name", "is", "alexa")

str_detect(string_vec, "alexa")
str_detect(string_vec, "my")
str_detect(string_vec, "My")


str_replace(string_vec, "my", "My")
# replace "my" in the string with "My"
```
```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "i think we all rule for participating",
  "i think i have been caught",
  "i think this will be quite fun actually",
  "it will be fun, i think"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "i think")
#"i think" anywhere in string 

str_detect(string_vec, "^i think")
# "i think" at the beginning

str_detect(string_vec, "^i think$")
# "i think" at the end
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "Time for a Pumpkin Spice Latte!",
  "went to the #pumpkinpatch last weekend",
  "Pumpkin Pie is obviously the best pie",
  "SMASHING PUMPKINS -- LIVE IN CONCERT!!"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "[Pp]umpkin")
# brackets mean that that letter can either be capital or lowercase

```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  '7th inning stretch',
  '1st half soon to begin. Texas won the toss.',
  'she is 5 feet 4 inches tall',
  '3AM - cant sleep :('
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "^[0-9][a-zA-Z]")
# brackets define ranges
# detects any number 0-9 followed immediately by any letter capital or lowercase
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'Its 7:11 in the evening',
  'want to go to 7-11?',
  'my flight is AA711',
  'NetBios: scanning ip 203.167.114.66'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "7.11")
# detects the numbers 7 and 11 with any character (.) in between 
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'The CI is [2, 5]',
  ':-]',
  ':-[',
  'I found the answer on pages [6-7]'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "\\[")
# the slash slash tells it to look for the subsequent character 
```

## quick note on factors
```{r}
vec_sex = factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female"))

as.numeric(vec_sex)

vec_sex = fct_relevel(vec_sex, "male")
```



## Import NSDUH
```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = read_html(url)
```

Pull the tables out
```{r}
marj_df =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1) |> 
  select(-contains("P Value")) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    -State,    # this applies the pivot longer to every variable except "State"
    names_to = "age_year",
    values_to = "prev"
  ) |> 
  separate(age_year, into = c("age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |>  # separate values by where the parenthesis is 
mutate(
  year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""), #replace any parenthesis in the values with nothing
prev = str_replace(prev, "[a-c]", ""), #replace any letters in the values with nothing
  prev = as.numeric(prev)
)
```

Make a quick plot
```{r}
marj_df |> 
  filter(age == "12-17") |> 
  mutate(State = fct_reorder(State, prev)) |> # puts state in order of ascneding prevalence instead of alphabetical order
  ggplot(aes(x = State, y = prev, color = year))+
  geom_point()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust = 1))
```

## NYC Airbnb
```{r}
data(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(price < 1000) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  coord_flip() # flips x and y axis
```

## Restaurant inspections

```{r}
data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec = 
  rest_inspec |> 
  rename(borough = boro)
```

Quick EDA
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
  
```

```{r}
rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |> 
  filter(
    borough != "0",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  )

rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
```

Look for pizza places
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "Pizza")) |> #dba is the column with names of the restaurants
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )

rest_inspec |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "[Pp][Ii][Zz][Zz][Aa]")) |> #allows for upper or lower case 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )
```


This is better
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> # makes all values of dba fully uppercase
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  count(borough, grade) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    values_from = n
  )

```

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_upper(dba)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade))+
  geom_bar()
```
This doesnt work
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(
    dba = str_to_upper(dba),
    borough = fct_infreq(borough),
    borough = str_replace(borough, "Manhattan", "The City")) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade))+
  geom_bar()
```
This does work
```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(
    dba = str_to_upper(dba),
    borough = fct_infreq(borough),
    borough = fct_recode(borough, "The City" = "Manhattan")) |> 
  filter(str_detect(dba, "PIZZA")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = borough, fill = grade))+
  geom_bar()
```
